einzeiler: Comedian Jared Freed discusses his new Netflix special and family dynamics.
kurzfassung: Comedian Jared Freed joins the show to discuss his new Netflix special, The Family Plan. He opens up about millennial relationships with parents, body image struggles, and using GLP-1 medications. The conversation also touches on his touring experiences and thoughts on dating advice.
stichpunkte: Jared Freed promotes his new Netflix comedy special, The Family Plan
Discussion centers on quirky family vacation dynamics and generational body image issues
Jared shares his positive experience taking a GLP-1 medication for weight and anxiety
The hosts explore the unique, often stressful relationships millennials have with their aging parents
Jared reflects on his sixteen-year stand-up career and the trial-and-error process of crafting bits
Talk turns to his dating advice book, Walking Red Flag, and perspective on relationships
Jared mentions his recent lifestyle changes, including quitting alcohol

clips.hook: The guy you're dating is not one hundred percent different than me.
clips.text: The author explains the core premise of his dating book by arguing that all single men share similar baseline flaws.
